verse.text: Come, my children, and listen to me, and I will teach you to fear the LORD.

video.title: Teach Your Children The Fear of God | Pastor How (Tan Seow How)

reflection: David wasn't lecturing from a pulpit when he wrote 'Come, my children, and listen to me' — he was inviting his kids into relationship, teaching by nearness, not just rules. That's the daily call for a father: sit close, talk often, and let your own reverence for God be the lesson your kids actually absorb. It won't happen in one big speech; it happens at the dinner table, in the car, at bedtime — the small, repeated moments where they learn to trust and fear the Lord because they've watched you do it first.
